stubs.name: BUFFER_TO_STRING

stubs.name: CALENDAR

VAR_INPUT
    STR : STRING[10];
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: OSCAT CHARCODE: returns the character code for an HTML entity name. It uses a lookup table, so the body is left empty.

stubs.name: CIRCLE_SEG

stubs.name: COUNT_CHAR

stubs.name: cPI

stubs.name: cPN

stubs.name: cT0
stubs.note: Absolute zero in °C. The value is inferred: T - cT0 is the temperature in Kelvin, and DEW_TEMP uses cT0 as its lower limit.

stubs.name: CYCLE_4

stubs.name: C_TO_F

stubs.note: OSCAT DAY_OF_MONTH: returns the day of the month (1..31). The call sites compare the result with integers, so it returns INT, not the inferred BOOL. The body is left empty.

stubs.name: DAY_OF_YEAR

END_FUNCTION

stubs.name: EXP10
stubs.note: OSCAT BASIC: returns 10 to the power X.

stubs.name: FSTRING_TO_WEEK
stubs.note: OSCAT BASIC: converts a list of weekday names to a BYTE bitmask. The body is left empty.

stubs.name: FSTRING_TO_WEEKDAY
stubs.note: OSCAT: turns a weekday name into its number (1..7), using the language tables. The parameter is a STRING of default length so a STRING[60] argument can be passed. No body, so it returns 0.

stubs.name: FT_INT2
stubs.note: OSCAT integrator that reads the PLC timer. No body, so OUT stays 0.

stubs.name: F_TO_C
stubs.note: OSCAT: converts Fahrenheit to Celsius.

stubs.name: GEN_PULSE
stubs.note: OSCAT pulse generator that depends on the system timer. No body.

stubs.name: HEX_TO_DWORD
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION HEX_TO_DWORD : DWORD
VAR_INPUT
    HEX : STRING[255];
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: OSCAT: turns a hex string into a DWORD and ignores characters that are not hex. Left without a body.

stubs.name: HYST_1
stubs.note: OSCAT hysteresis: Q switches on above HIGH and off below LOW. WIN is TRUE while IN is between LOW and HIGH.

stubs.name: INC1
stubs.note: OSCAT: adds 1 to X and wraps to 0 when it reaches N-1.

stubs.name: INC2
stubs.note: OSCAT: adds D to X and wraps the result inside the range L..U.

stubs.name: INTERLOCK
stubs.note: OSCAT: two mutually exclusive outputs with a lockout time, which uses the timer. No body.

stubs.name: _RMP_B
stubs.note: OSCAT BASIC: ramps the byte passed through RMP from 0 to 255 over the time TR, upward or downward according to DIR. The real block reads the system time, so this stub has no body and leaves RMP unchanged.

stubs.name: _RMP_NEXT
stubs.note: OSCAT BASIC: ramps OUT toward IN, with TR as the rise time, TF as the fall time and TL as the lock-out time, and reports the direction in UP and DN. The real block reads the system time, so this stub has no body. Some calls pass a DINT to IN, which is declared BYTE as in OSCAT.

stubs.name: _STRING_TO_BUFFER
stubs.note: OSCAT BASIC: copies STR into the buffer at PT starting at POS, limited by SIZE, and returns the position after the last byte written. The calls ignore the result. The copy works through a pointer and the exact end-position rules are not documented here, so the body is empty. STRING_LENGTH is a constant that the library defines.
